annotations.title: YouTube search and video statistics, live

description: Search YouTube or look up videos by id, each with live statistics read at call time from the YouTube Data API v3: title, channel, upload time, duration, views, likes, comments, live flag and thumbnail. A query runs YouTube's own video search (sort by relevance, date, views, rating or title; filter by upload date, country, language) plus one details call; video_ids skips it. Input: query or video_ids; optional max_results, order, published_after, region_code, language. $0.05 per call. Returns: query, video_ids, total_results, items[{video_id, url, title, description, channel_id, channel_title, published_at, duration_seconds, view_count, like_count, comment_count, live, thumbnail_url}], item_count, source, as_of, checked_at.

language.description: With query: ISO 639 language code of the results to prefer, e.g. en, ja.

max_results.description: With query: videos to return, default 10.

order.description: With query: YouTube's sort, default relevance.

published_after.description: With query: only videos uploaded at or after this RFC 3339 time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

query.description: Words to search YouTube for, in any language. Use this OR `video_ids`.

region_code.description: With query: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country whose results to prefer, e.g. US, JP.

video_ids.description: YouTube video ids (11 characters) to look up directly; skips the search.

name: hubvibe_video_youtube

outputSchema.description: The 200 body of every paid /work call. `result` is the worker's own output (its schema is per route); everything else is the same on every /work route. A receipt for the job is at `receipt_url`.

billing_warning.description: Present only when the charge was recorded with a caveat.

price_usd.description: What this call cost, in USD.

provenance.description: How the result was produced: which providers ran and how long each took.

attempts.description: Provider attempts made, including retries and failovers.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the whole job.

steps.description: Every step the job ran, in order.

reason.description: Failure reason, on a failed step.

receipt_url.description: Where to fetch the machine-readable receipt (free, no payment).

as_of.description: The same instant as checked_at: YouTube does not stamp its statistics.

checked_at.description: When this node read the source (UTC). Nothing here is cached.

items.description: Videos, in YouTube's search order (or the order of the ids asked); ids YouTube does not know are absent.
One video, with its live statistics.

comment_count.description: Comments; null when hidden or comments are off.

description.description: Description, cut at 500 characters; null when empty.
examples: A short intro to open source licences.

duration_seconds.description: Length in whole seconds from contentDetails.duration; 0 for a live or upcoming stream; null when YouTube did not return the video's details.

like_count.description: Likes; null when the uploader hides them.

live.description: Live or upcoming broadcast (liveBroadcastContent is not none); null when not stated.

published_at.description: Upload time as YouTube states it (ISO 8601).

thumbnail_url.description: Thumbnail URL, the high size when YouTube offers it.

view_count.description: Views; null when YouTube does not send it.

query.description: The query as given; null when video_ids were looked up.

total_results.description: YouTube's estimated total matches for the query (pageInfo.totalResults); null when not sent.

video_ids.description: The ids asked for, in order; null when a query was searched.

status.description: Present only on a delivered result.

worker.description: Catalog name of the worker that ran.

outputSchema.title: video.youtube response

title: YouTube search and video statistics, live
